name: Stage cues for the autumn cultural afternoon
subject: events
brief: Your stage crew of three is putting on the Class XI one-act play at the autumn cultural afternoon: bracing the painted courtyard flats, ringing the offstage bell and playing the harmonium chord, and holding the prompt book. You are in the chair and the dress-rehearsal bell rings in minutes. Nobody has said when the stage is actually yours, or who else may be using it.

tasks.name: Shift and brace the painted courtyard flats
Ring the offstage cycle bell and harmonium chord
Follow the script in the wings as prompter

facts.text: The music teacher has booked the stage for the Class XII chorus from 3:00 to 3:30 p.m., right across your rehearsal slot
Arup brought an old brass rickshaw bell for the street-scene cue

note: Uses Tara Das (npc_tara_das) at Nabapara Vidyalaya (loc_nhss). The constraint is the 3:00 p.m. stage booking clash with the Class XII chorus known to Tara; the seam is that the prompt copy and the sound-cue slip number the curtain cues differently.
